definitions.explanation: Bags and belongings that passengers carry with them onto a plane, train, or other transportation, as opposed to checked luggage.

examples.japanese: {手荷物|てにもつ}は{一|ひと}つまでです。
examples.english: You can have only one piece of carry-on luggage.

examples.japanese: {手荷物|てにもつ}{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けてください。
examples.english: Please go through the baggage inspection.

examples.japanese: {手荷物|てにもつ}は{座席|ざせき}の{下|した}か{上|うえ}の{棚|たな}に{収納|しゅうのう}してください。
examples.english: Please store your hand luggage under your seat or in the overhead bin.

notes:
A common travel term used at airports and train stations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手荷物|てにもつ}{検査|けんさ} (baggage inspection/security check)
- {手荷物|てにもつ}{預|あず}かり{所|じょ} (baggage storage/left luggage)
- {手荷物|てにもつ}{制限|せいげん} (carry-on restrictions)
- {手荷物|てにもつ}を{持|も}ち{込|こ}む (to bring carry-on luggage)

RELATED WORDS:
- {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}: checked baggage
- {機内|きない}{持|も}ち{込|こ}み: carry-on (for flights)
- {荷物|にもつ}: luggage, baggage

cross_references.headword: {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}
